# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |
| Old     | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project (e.g. cross-site scripting, sensitive data exposure, insecure resource injection), please **DO NOT** open a public issue.

Instead, please email **STS.Consulting@hotmail.com** with the subject line `Security Vulnerability - STS-Consulting.github.io`.

You can also use our [Security Notification Template](SECURITY_NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE.md) to format your disclosure.

We will attempt to respond within 48 hours to acknowledge your report.
